title: Trigger-2 Qwen3.5-0.8B Binding/Remap Training Curriculum (B0-B6 + course-section-2 A/G)
summary: Candidate (METHOD_ONLY, training_eligible=false) training-row generators and materialized data for the Qwen3.5-0.8B Xeno binding/remap curriculum, built 2026-08-26 by claude-code-lead across one extended session under Gabriel's direct instruction to reach 10k rows and then perfect them: B0 semantic-READ/symbol-WRITE baselines (612 rows), B1 arbitrary episode-local binding (9072-row audited factorial pool + a chatgpt-secondary-recommended 2304-row balanced TRAIN mix-tier, both fail-closed gated on a corrected leakage audit), B2 semantic-prior-override/mid-episode-remap/stale-binding-rejection (1800 rows), B3 multi-hop dereference (2160 rows), B4 delay/interference capacity curves and B5 variable-N/cell-permutation equivariance (pre-existing sibling-agent work, verified reproducible this session), B6 system-integration (DB-vs-sim/Claude-handoff/Hyperposition, pre-existing plus a newly closed GWT broadcast/uptake/causal-re-entry gap, 2160 rows) -- plus course section 2's two previously-zero-investment lettered gaps A (autonomous boot/work selection, 1556 rows) and G (recursive coordinator compression, 876 rows). Every family shares one disciplined pattern: deterministic generation, an explicit fail-closed leakage/nuisance audit specific to that family's design, cross-process reproducibility verification, and honest non-inflation of accepted_dataset_tokens (remains 0 everywhere -- real tokenizer/ABI binding is a separate, later, still-open gate, tracked in the sibling packet trigger2-canonical-atom-abi-namespace).
open_questions: Course section E (stale/CAS/rebase/recovery) is only partially covered -- B2's STALE_BINDING_REJECTION and B6's DB_VS_SIM STALE_REBASE_REQUIRED class test stale-state recognition, but not full CAS/epoch/digest rebase mechanics.

Course sections C (ordinary-node NODE_RESULT), D (dynamic coordinator cognition) and J (memory/effect proposal semantics) have existing SOURCE-level generators from earlier sessions (tools/trigger2_node_result_model_call_authority_envelope_v1.py, tools/trigger2_cognitive_process_executable_transition_generator_v2.py, tools/trigger2_protocol_packet_projection_generator_v1.py) with no materialized committed candidate rows found -- neither closed nor untouched, genuinely unresolved.
How should the B1 full 9072-row pool versus the 2304-row balanced mix-tier actually be weighted in the eventual combined 10k assembly relative to B0/B2/B3/B4/B5/B6/A/G's own row counts?

Does the leakage-audit discipline (uniqueness, cross-split disjointness, text-conditional target uniformity, within-split + excess-over-baseline joint MI) generalize cleanly once placeholder ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL atoms are replaced by real single-token atoms under the canonical split manifest (see trigger2-canonical-atom-abi-namespace), or do exact tokenizer boundary effects reopen any of the checks?
